actor: Codex, already familiar with and editing the tool

application.name: TodoMVC Vue
application.scope: Complete unchanged upstream prebuilt application; official maintained framework showcase, not a production product.

timingLimitations: Wall-clock milestones include source research, tool feature implementation and assistant work. They are not independent first-use measurements.
The first runtime result preceded correction of a TypeScript readonly-array error in the generator.
Tool dependencies and Chromium were already installed; the upstream prebuilt app required no dependency installation or rebuild.
Filesystem log/report modification times provide completion timestamps; they do not measure active coding time.

friction.detail: The runner required an HTTP fixture even though this app receives data through a native form.
friction.resolution: Added a declarative form input boundary.

friction.detail: The app deliberately reveals delete on hover, but hover was not a supported setup action.
friction.resolution: Added an explicit hover setup action.

friction.detail: Rendered proofs required a single scalar or JSON attribute; the native app exposes a list of labels.
The checked-in upstream HTML, JavaScript, CSS and metadata needed to be served without Vite rewriting.
friction.resolution: Added a restricted raw subject server and raw build asset copies.

friction.detail: The first TypeScript check rejected readonly tuples from the seeded title generator.
friction.resolution: Copied generated titles into mutable arrays and reran type checking and tests.

nextTrial.userPreference: Prepare a self-guided trial for later
